faces.text:
{icon_fanfare|[fanfare]} Select up to 1 Cute follower that costs 4 or less and up to 1 Cute follower that costs 2 or less in your cemetery. Summon them and give them {icon_power|[attack]}+1/{icon_hp|[defense]}+1.

qa.title: Q888 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I summon Kyoko Igarashi [P.C.S.] and Miho Kohinata [P.C.S.] with Uzuki Shimamura [P.C.S.]'s Fanfare ability, in what order are their Fanfare abilities resolved?
qa.answer: When multiple followers with Fanfare abilities are summoned with the same ability, you can resolve their triggered Fanfare abilities in any order.

qa.title: Q889 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: Can I choose not to add the top card of my deck to my hand even if it is a Cute card?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. If you choose not to add it to your hand, return it to the top of your deck without revealing it.
